latest.title: Spectral complexes and currents on the Engel group
latest.abstract: We study the spectral complexes arising from the de Rham complex on the Engel group $G$ viewed as a truncated multicomplex. We describe the two resulting complexes, analyse their compactly supported counterparts, and define the corresponding spectral currents by duality. We prove that the smooth spectral complexes embed naturally into the current complexes. Finally, we show that the Pansu pullback of a $W_{\mathrm{loc}}^{1,q}$ map $\varphi\colon G\to G$ with $q>7$ induces a morphism into the corresponding complexes of spectral currents.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 构造 Engel 群 de Rham 多重复形对应的谱复形及流，并建立 Sobolev 映射的 Pansu 拉回态射。
latest.breakthrough: 将光滑谱复形嵌入流复形，处理 q>7 的弱正则拉回。
latest.limitations: q 阈值和 Engel 群结构关键，不是一般 Carnot 群的无条件结果。 已补读引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。
